expected_root_cause: The pod runs under the sample-sa ServiceAccount, which has no RBAC permissions granted (no ClusterRoleBinding or RoleBinding references it). Its in-cluster API call fails with a 403 Forbidden error, visible in the pod's logs, causing the container to keep failing and restarting.
key_evidence: get_pod_logs shows a Forbidden error, e.g. pods is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:<namespace>:sample-sa" cannot list resource
No ClusterRoleBinding (or RoleBinding) exists that grants sample-sa the permission it's trying to use
should_not_conclude: An application code bug unrelated to permissions
